mapper.select: select coalesce((select sum(p.total_cents) from purchase_orders p join documents d on d.id=p.document_id where d.type='PURCHASE_ORDER' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' and (#{admin}=true or d.creator_id=#{userId})),0) valid_order_cents,coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='APPROVED' and d.deleted='0' and (#{admin}=true or d.creator_id=#{userId})),0) approved_invoice_cents,coalesce((select sum(i.total_cents) from invoices i join documents d on d.id=i.document_id where d.type='INVOICE' and d.approval_status='IN_REVIEW' and d.deleted='0' and (#{admin}=true or d.creator_id=#{userId})),0) pending_invoice_cents,(select count(1) from receipts r join documents d on d.id=r.document_id where d.deleted='0' and (#{admin}=true or d.creator_id=#{userId})) receipt_count,(select count(1) from workflow_tasks where assignee_id=#{userId} and status='PENDING') pending_task_count
